questions.stem: 在超市購物時，很少人會仔細看標示，了解食品裡究竟添加了哪些成分。
questions.answer: When shopping at supermarkets, few people read the labels carefully to find out what ingredients have actually been added to the food.
accepted_answers: While shopping in a supermarket, only a few people check the labels carefully to learn which ingredients have really been put into the food.
When doing their shopping at the supermarket, few people take a careful look at the labels to find out exactly what ingredients have been added to the food.

questions.stem: 對於常吃含有大量糖、鹽的超加工食品（ultra-processed food）的人來說，罹患慢性病的風險明顯較高。
questions.answer: For those who often eat ultra-processed foods containing lots of sugar and salt, the risk of developing chronic diseases is significantly higher.
accepted_answers: For those who regularly consume ultra-processed food loaded with sugar and salt, the risk of getting chronic illnesses is clearly higher.
Those who frequently eat ultra-processed foods containing large amounts of sugar and salt face a much higher risk of chronic diseases.

1.explanation_zh: 「在…時」沒有主詞，主詞和後面的「人」相同，可寫 When shopping at supermarkets（連接詞＋分詞），主要子句的主詞要是人，避免懸垂分詞。「很少人」是 few people（a few 是「有一些」）。「了解…添加了哪些成分」用 to find out + what ingredients + 直述句語序；成分是被加入的，用 have been added to。
1.strategy_zh: 「在…時」主詞相同時可以寫 When + V-ing；「…了哪些／什麼」放在動詞後面當受詞，用 what／which 子句、直述句語序。
hints: 切成四段：在超市購物時／很少人會仔細看標示／了解（哪些成分）／究竟添加了
標的詞彙：supermarket（超市）、shop（購物）、few（很少的）、label（標示）、ingredient（成分）、add（添加）
句型框架：When + V-ing …, few people + V … to find out what + N + have been p.p. …

2.explanation_zh: 「對於常吃…的人來說」用 For those who often eat …（those 複數，動詞用原形）。「含有大量糖、鹽的超加工食品」中文修飾語在前，英文用現在分詞片語後位修飾 ultra-processed foods containing lots of sugar and salt（sugar、salt 不可數）。「罹患慢性病的風險」是 the risk of developing chronic diseases（risk of + V-ing；慢性病不用 catch）；「明顯較高」用 significantly／much higher（very 不能修飾比較級）。
evidence: 含有大量糖、鹽的超加工食品
2.strategy_zh: 名詞前面的修飾語很長（含動詞＋受詞）時，改成名詞＋分詞片語；「對於…的人來說」直接想 For those who …。
hints: 切成四段：對於常吃…的人來說／含有大量糖、鹽的超加工食品／罹患慢性病的風險／明顯較高
標的詞彙：contain（含有）、sugar（糖）、chronic（慢性的）、disease（疾病）、risk（風險）、significantly（明顯地）
句型框架：For those who + V + N + V-ing …, the risk of + V-ing … is + significantly + 比較級

While shopping in a supermarket, only a few people check the labels carefully to learn which ingredients have really been put into the food.
When doing their shopping at the supermarket, few people take a careful look at the labels to find out exactly what ingredients have been added to the food.

1.restructuring_zh: 「在超市購物時」沒有主詞，英文用 When shopping … 的分詞構句，主要子句要以購物的人（few people）當主詞；「了解…添加了哪些成分」改成目的不定詞 to find out ＋ what 名詞子句。

traps.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語放在「食品」前面；英文帶受詞的修飾語要用分詞片語放在名詞後面：foods containing lots of sugar and salt。

bonus.text: Those who often eat ultra-processed foods laden with sugar and salt are far more likely to develop chronic diseases.
bonus.explanation_zh: be (far) more likely to V（更可能…）把「風險較高」改寫成形容詞句型；laden with（充滿）是較正式的分詞修飾。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文「對於…的人來說，…的風險較高」可照譯成 For those who …, the risk of … is higher，也可直接以 Those who … 當主詞：Those who … face a higher risk of …；「含有大量糖、鹽的」要用分詞片語放在食品後面。

1.translation: When shopping at the supermarket, few people read the labels carefully to find out exactly what ingredients have been added to the food.
1.explanation_zh: 「在超市購物時」用省略主詞的副詞子句 When shopping；「很少人」用 few people（否定意味）；「了解…究竟添加了哪些成分」用間接問句 what ingredients have been added，「究竟」譯為 exactly。

2.translation: For people who often eat ultra-processed food containing large amounts of sugar and salt, the risk of developing chronic diseases is significantly higher.
2.explanation_zh: 「對於…的人來說」照原結構用 For people who ...；「含有大量糖、鹽的」用現在分詞片語 containing large amounts of sugar and salt 後位修飾；「罹患慢性病」用 develop chronic diseases；「明顯較高」用 significantly higher。

issues_zh: 4 部分的中文標示沒有涵蓋「食品裡」「哪些成分」：第 3 部分中文只標「了解」，卻 targets NCL、ingredient，accepted 也含 what ingredients；第 4 部分中文標「究竟添加了」，accepted 卻含 to the food，而「究竟」的 exactly 在 accepted 裡反而放在第 3 部分。中英對應錯位，閱卷者照中文標示評分會混淆，建議第 3 部分改標「了解…究竟…哪些成分」、第 4 部分改標「食品裡…添加了」。
（小問題）R1 的 clearly higher 譯「明顯較高」可以，但 significantly／noticeably higher 較自然。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：4 部分的中文標示沒有涵蓋「食品裡」「哪些成分」：第 3 部分中文只標「了解」，卻 targets NCL、ingredient，accepted 也含 what ingredients；第 4 部分中文標「究竟添加了」，accepted

1.translation: When shopping at the supermarket, few people read the labels carefully to learn exactly what ingredients have been added to the food.
1.explanation_zh: 「在超市購物時」用省略主詞的 When shopping；「很少人」用 few people；「了解……究竟添加了哪些成分」用不定詞加 what ingredients 的名詞子句，被動用現在完成式 have been added。

2.translation: For people who often eat ultra-processed food containing large amounts of sugar and salt, the risk of developing chronic diseases is significantly higher.
2.explanation_zh: 「對於常吃……的人來說」用 For people who ...；「含有大量糖、鹽」用現在分詞 containing large amounts of；罹患慢性病用 developing chronic diseases；「明顯較高」用 significantly higher。
